rule: Fill-path only, mapped by sheet geometry: each join targets the fillable cell whose printed caption (from the frozen page's own text layer) names the item. Text cells and combs: caption beside or above the cell, or the column header of the NOLCO and Schedule 5 tables. Booleans: X in the box immediately left of the printed option (Yes/No, civil status, filing status, taxpayer type, ATC, tax rate and deduction method, overpayment). Amounts: every amount is a 9-slot whole-peso comb with no centavo comb, so they are peso_joins: the writer value (1,234.00) is parsed, rounded to whole pesos (50 centavos up) and right-aligned. No money_joins exist on this sheet. The Part VI summary (page 4) prints from txtPg4ISc6_*: the official layout names that family Part VI. The item 1 sheet has only a YYYY comb. Stamped TIN cells keep their catalog name=. Split dates print through date_joins (MM, DD, YYYY combs from one key); the email prints as typed; the page 2-4 TIN combs and the Item 33 digit boxes print from derived: keys of Form1701Draft::to_print_field_map. The signature block stays blank. Since #113 every value the print map carries has a box or a reviewed not_joined reason.
